name: Great Bear Spirit

angles.text: Communing with the Great Bear Spirit is an essential rite of passage for every druid, imparting the natural wisdom and spiritual foundation needed to adopt the bear's resilience.

faq.answer: The Great Bear Spirit resides in the northwestern reaches of Moonglade, dwelling apart from the settlement of Nighthaven in the wilder borders of the sacred refuge.
faq.q: Where can the Great Bear Spirit be found?

aliases: who sends you to bear spirit
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze, an elder druid stationed in Nighthaven, directs initiates to commune with the spirit as part of their natural training.
faq.q: Who sends druids to seek out the Great Bear Spirit?

faq.answer: The Great Bear Spirit is revered as a wise and noble entity that serves as a guide, tutor, and mentor into the primal understanding of the bear for all practicing druids.
faq.q: What is the Great Bear Spirit?

aliases: what do you learn from bear spirit
faq.answer: Initiates seek out the spirit to learn about the core nature of the bear, absorbing its raw strength, resilience, and wisdom before returning to channel those qualities in their craft.
faq.q: Why must druids commune with the Great Bear Spirit?

faq.answer: Upon communing with the spirit, initiates return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, who recognizes their newly acquired understanding and prepares them to harness and focus that power.
faq.q: What happens after the Great Bear Spirit is satisfied?

aliases: do all druids visit bear spirit
faq.answer: Every druid must eventually seek the Great Bear Spirit's counsel, as communion with the spirit is considered a fundamental step in attuning to animal forms and natural power.
faq.q: Do all druids need to seek the spirit's wisdom?

sections.body: The Great Bear Spirit dwells in the northwestern wilds of Moonglade, secluded from the quiet paths of Nighthaven. Respected as a noble and ancient mentor, the spirit serves as the foundational tutor for all initiates seeking to understand the natural essence of the bear. Seeking its blessing and wisdom is a sacred tradition shared by every druid who walks the path of the wild.
sections.title: The Noble Mentor of Moonglade

sections.body: Guided by Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, young druids journey into the hills to present themselves before the spirit. Communing with the Great Bear Spirit imparts a primal wisdom and an awareness of natural strength. Upon their return, Dendrite tests their focus, observing that while the encounter instills raw strength and knowing intent, the druid must then learn to direct that inner power into their everyday work.
sections.title: A Rite of Primal Focus

summary: The Great Bear Spirit is a foundational mentor quest for druids in Moonglade, directing initiates to seek out an ancient and noble spirit in the northwestern wilderness. Communing with the spirit imparts essential wisdom regarding the nature and strength of the bear, marking a crucial step in a druid's spiritual and martial training.
attribution: In-game quest text: Great Bear Spirit
